summary: Jest is maintained (30.x) and fine for existing suites. In a Vite project, prefer Vitest: it reuses vite.config, handles ESM and TS natively, and its API is Jest-compatible. Not a reason to rewrite a working non-Vite Jest suite.

replacements.name: vitest
replacements.when: Vite-based projects (Vitest 5 needs Vite >= 6.4 and Node >= 22.12)
